title: Infinite polynomial sum-product boosting for geometric Ramsey families
author: Matt Bowen
difficulty_reason: The counted proposition must boost an arbitrary geometric Ramsey family, not just find a singleton sum/product pattern. Its author proof builds a branching color-focusing tree with recursively chosen finite pattern sets, synchronizes each branch by full descendant color tuples, frontloads polynomial recurrence into nested piecewise-syndetic sets before multiplicative shifts, and then uses consistent coordinatewise products across repeated-color levels to preserve the geometric family while obtaining an infinite A and all prescribed polynomial shifts. This is a concrete non-routine construction beyond ordinary qualifying exercises, and its full current proof remains in the item. H2 is used without an independent correctness or novelty certification.
